translation: Coloca, ó YHWH, ⟨um⟩ guarda ⟨para⟩ minha boca; vigia ⟨sobre⟩ a porta ⟨de⟩ meus lábios.

tokens.rationale: Hebrew noun 'shamarah' (watchfulness) requires an article in Portuguese for natural grammar
Preposition 'lə-' indicates purpose/relation, rendered as 'para' in Portuguese
Verb 'natzrah' (to guard) in imperative form, continuing the metaphor from 'shamarah'
Hebrew 'del' literally means valve/swinging thing, extended to 'door' in this metaphorical context
Possessive pronoun added in Portuguese; Hebrew 'səfatāy' is 'my lips' (1st common singular suffix)
